escalations_for_pi.kind: INSTRUMENT — era_check resolves at the wrong era for banner-carrying snapshot documents
escalations_for_pi.severity: high (process); zero wave-5 verdicts depended on it (all passes re-resolved eras manually)
escalations_for_pi.detail: find_era_commit picks the newest commit holding the extraction's blob; ruling-1 banners rewrite the blob, so the computed era lands at the banner date and era_check degenerates into a HEAD restatement. Three blind passes confirmed independently; quantified: 134 of 178 era_check rows report actual_era == actual with era commits clustering at 2026-08-01/02; all 110 MISMATCH rows on the phase3a audit repo-wide carry a false faithful:false, 67 of them in batch 043 (wave 3) — earlier triage was blind-pass-driven, not era_check-driven, so no adjudication is known to be contaminated, but the field cannot separate divergence from defect anywhere in the corpus today. Candidate fixes (PI to choose; charter-adjacent instrument redesign): resolve the era over the claim's own source lines (git log -L), select by verbatim-span presence, use the oldest commit holding the blob, and emit an explicit anchor-absent-at-era status. Per ruling 14 the era_check extension is registered instrument work.
